summary: Daqo New Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports financial and operational metrics such as revenue of $26.7 million, net loss of $88.4 million, and polysilicon production volumes. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change — is announced or discussed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. The category is None.
